compatibility: Not imported by existing runtime schemas; retain existing asset/project kinds.

time_fields.document_date: Raw source value plus date/month/quarter/unknown precision; no imputed UTC
time_fields.source_posted_at: Explicit source timezone or null normalized instant; retain naive raw timestamp
time_fields.reporting_period: Series-specific period and frequency, distinct from posting date
time_fields.action_or_effective_date: Contract/regulatory/ownership date with its own precision
time_fields.first_observed_at: Explicit timezone from actual collection receipt
time_fields.known_from: When this mapping or fact became known; never backdate from effective_date
time_fields.timezone_basis: Exact source documentation/evidence reference or null

identifiers.nrc_accession: Document-native AccessionNumber; required for APS evidence
identifiers.nrc_dockets: Zero or more source-provided strings; not an approval or event count
identifiers.issuer: Reviewed legal entity ID and evidenced CIK when available
identifiers.security: Existing instrument/listing ID with validity interval; symbol alone is insufficient
identifiers.recipient: Source-supplied UEI when available; no inferred parent

percentage_rules: Direct legal ownership is not operator share
Reject incompatible overlapping intervals or double counting
Do not traverse unreviewed or temporally incompatible parent edges
proof_requirements: Existing text evidence spans when available
Proposed typed JSON-pointer/cell-row proofs require a new validated proof contract
Evidence/revision IDs, native row key, original units, field name and source policy
Table/JSON support is not currently accepted by validator.validate

constraints: A docket number alone establishes no stage
Stages can be parallel, conditional or revisited; do not infer a strict linear state machine
Issued authorization requires exact NRC decision, subject, activity, conditions and effective date
Issuer forecasts remain issuer-reported future events
A safety evaluation or environmental document alone does not establish every license condition is satisfied

lineage_contract.rule: Collapse documented NRC-derived EIA observations into shared lineage; distinguish different independently sourced observations.

constraints: Reviewed exact route, method and bounded body schema before DNS
Credential handle in approved local mechanism, never its value in state
Redact query credentials and echoed response request fields before persistence
Retain existing SSRF/path/redirect/size checks and shared quota accounting
No automatic quota expansion or scheduler
Unknown content/fields/totals or paging cap produce visible coverage debt
